analysis.body:
Per the Census Bureau, 36.5% of finance and insurance firms (NAICS 52) answered yes to using AI in the last two weeks, compared with 40.0% in the prior period. That category is broader than banking alone, but it is the official adoption figure the survey reports for the sector.

The Evident AI Banking Index, launched in January 2023, scores major global banks across dozens of quantitative maturity metrics including talent, innovation, leadership, and transparency. Evident describes banks as racing to incorporate AI into almost everything they do, and notes that AI is breathing new life into Wall Street's tech hiring scene even as landing a software job in finance has become more challenging than in recent years.

The World of AI catalogues the 1000 most-downloaded open financial models on the Hugging Face Hub, refreshed daily with licence, downloads, and release date. The models are tuned for financial text, which gives banks a visible supply of open tooling for financial language tasks.

The Federal Reserve's SR 11-7 model risk management guidance, issued in 2011, already covers credit and AML models, so banking AI governance predates the current AI boom by more than a decade. The page's framing describes fraud detection and credit models as decades old, with generative AI in service and compliance as the new frontier. Treasury has also mapped the risk surface with a report on AI in financial services covering uses, opportunities, and risks, which frames the US supervisory conversation.

For a reader deciding whether to deploy, the material points to a sector with mature model risk rules, a public benchmark for comparing bank AI maturity, and open models available for experimentation. The Census figure shows adoption is not a straight line, and the sources emphasize governance and benchmarking over ROI or vendor concentration.

https://evidentinsights.com/.brief: Evident Insights is an intelligence platform that benchmarks and tracks AI adoption across the financial services sector. It supplies data, research, and benchmarking to help financial services leaders make informed AI-related decisions, investments, and strategic choices. The platform publishes the Evident AI Index, which ranks banks and insurers on their AI deployment and highlights emerging trends. Since launching in January 2023, the index has sparked debate and received widespread press coverage, with Evident CEO Alexandra Mousavizadeh frequently commenting on global AI trends.

https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-rel.brief: On International Anti-Corruption Day, Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctioned 28 individuals and businesses tied to a Zimbabwe-based gold smuggling and money-laundering network led by Kamlesh Pattni. The Treasury says the scheme bribed officials, used trusted supporters to conceal ownership, and built a global web of companies to hide illicit activity, depriving Zimbabwe’s citizens of resource benefits while enriching corrupt officials and criminals. Acting Under Secretary Bradley T. Smith noted that “Corruption respects no borders” and that the action demonstrates a whole-of-government approach and collaboration with allies. The Treasury’s move is carried out under Executive Order 13818, which targets serious human-rights abuse and corruption worldwide. International Anti-Corruption Day, observed annually on December 9 since the 2003 UNCAC, aims to raise awareness of anti-corruption initiatives; the United Nations lists 189 parties to the convention.

https://www.federalreserve.gov/supervisi.brief: This page lists the Federal Reserve Board of Governors’ 2011 supervision and regulation letters. It notes that a lock icon or https indicates a secure .gov connection and advises “Share sensitive information only on official, secure websites.” It also contains guidance on prior notices concerning dividend declarations by savings association subsidiaries of savings and loan holding companies.

https://theworldofai.org/ai-ecosystem/te.brief: The page reports that it catalogues the 1,000 most-downloaded open financial models on the Hugging Face Hub, including each model’s licence, download count, and release date. According to the page, the listing is refreshed daily and is built from the Hugging Face Hub public API, sorted by all-time downloads. Each model entry links to its own page on the Hub. The page states it was last verified on 2026-09-21.
